trust_decision.summary: Application-supplied response header names and values are written verbatim onto the wire with no CR/LF check; the only place this is (not) decided is encoder.encode_headers, which every response path calls.

landing_point.why: The summary says 'CRLF in HTTP headers'; the only header serialiser in the tree is encode_headers, found with one search for \r\n.

fix_sites.entry_point: Handler passed to ewe.new (src/ewe.gleam:373) returning a Response with headers; reached through encode_response (src/ewe/internal/encoder.gleam:8) from src/ewe/internal/http1/handler.gleam:292 and encode_response_partially (src/ewe/internal/encoder.gleam:19) from src/ewe/internal/http1/handler.gleam:227

O3_reason_to_dismiss: None that holds: chunked (src/ewe/internal/stream/chunked.gleam:24), SSE (src/ewe/internal/stream/sse.gleam:23) and websocket (src/ewe/internal/http1.gleam:818) all call the same encoder, so a fix in encode_headers covers them by construction.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Legitimate header values with internal spaces/HTAB (e.g. date from clock.get_http_date, user values like 'text/html; charset=utf-8') must still be emitted; an over-broad fix that rejects all control/whitespace or drops the response would break them.

O6_input_shapes: CR or LF in header value
CR or LF in header name

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A trailer-emitting chunk terminator that writes user trailer headers by hand instead of via encode_headers.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Response trailers are a natural feature next to the existing request-trailer support (src/ewe/internal/http1.gleam:494-535); a maintainer would likely format them inline beside send_end.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Websocket handshake that echoes a negotiated sec-websocket-protocol from the request via a hand-built header block.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Subprotocol negotiation is a common missing feature here; still a where-type sibling that funnels into the same encoder unless planted as a separate formatter.

O9_family: CWE-113 HTTP response header CRLF injection (response splitting)

O10_build.project_tests: test/http_test.gleam, test/h1spec_test.gleam, test/ewe_test.gleam with a raw TCP client (test/client/tcp.gleam, test/client/http.gleam); no response-header CRLF tests at the pinned commit.

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Strip or reject \r and \n in header values only inside encode_headers, forgetting header names; this is also essentially the complete fix.

out_of_scope_notes: SSE event fields: event/id values are written raw with a trailing \n (src/ewe/internal/stream/sse.gleam:170-172) and data splits only on \n (src/ewe/internal/stream/sse.gleam:148-152), so a bare CR or LF can inject SSE fields; that is event-stream body, not HTTP headers, and was not pursued.
